_readme: Draft Fotheringhay walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: Back to the Falcon

layers.essential_history: [[c:Back where you started. Few villages so small have seen so much royal history.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Fotheringhay's story runs from Edward III, through the Dukes of York and Richard III, to Mary, Queen of Scots.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The King arrives at dawn. Before he does, say who took the white rose.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:That's the end of the walk. Well done, detective!]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Who took the white rose?]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Look through your evidence notebook, then make your accusation.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who took the rose, why, and where is it now?]]

fields.label: Why?
options: To melt down the silver and sell it
fields.answer: To melt down the silver and sell it

fields.label: Where is it now?
options: In a wine barrel across the river
fields.answer: In a wine barrel across the river

puzzle.reveal: [[c:It was Master Lucas Venn. He carried the rose across the ford in a sack and hid it in a wine barrel on the far bank, meaning to melt down the silver in London. The rose is back in the church before the King arrives.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:You can solve this from your notebook alone.]]
